facts.statement: SOE Podcast #68 (posted August 4, 2009) included news about Free Realms alongside EQ, EQ2 and Vanguard, and an interview with Free Realms Brand Manager Candace Ivy.
facts.quote: we include an interview with Candace Ivy, the Brand Manager for Free Realms

article_summaries.title: SOE Podcast #68 - News and Block Party Pics
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer post announcing SOE Podcast #68, a general SOE podcast covering Free Realms along with EverQuest, EverQuest II and Vanguard. The only Free Realms-specific content named is an interview with Candace Ivy, the game's Brand Manager, plus Block Party 2009 pictures. It contains no gameplay, quest, item or price details.
